OMX_CLAP_REPLIES.description: The replies of the verbs omx-clap-host answers whose shape this package owns, typed, by the verb's title (the verbs are plugin-hostd-protocol's, PLUGIN_HOSTD_PROTOCOL_SHARED_VERBS and PLUGIN_HOSTD_PROTOCOL_CLAP_HOST_VERBS of its domain plugin-hostd-protocol): resp 0 or resp count, then name:type for each field, in the form of plugin-hostd-protocol's reply_forms (plugin-hostd-protocol#19), each type an arg_type of the protocol's table or one of OMX_CLAP_REPLY_TYPES. Each is the verb's x-reply with every <name> typed; a client decodes the reply by it as it decodes the protocol's own. The replies the protocol's table types (note_input, note_drops and note_out_drops among them, its reply_forms) are its, never typed here. Read at run time; tests/host-replies-check.py holds it to the x-replies and to the fields the code writes.

x-value.idleHold: resp 0 target:hold held:hold aggregate:microseconds active:uint code:word

OMX_CLAP_REPLY_TYPES.description: The types of OMX_CLAP_REPLIES that plugin-hostd-protocol's table does not declare, each declared once: its pattern, which a field of the type matches whole, and its spelling in x-docs.

x-docs.hold: the CPU idle hold, off for none, else its latency in microseconds
x-docs.microseconds: a latency in microseconds, or - when it cannot be read
